description: This is a test file for various functions related to spawned context management in an OpenClaw project. It contains test cases written with the Vitest framework for functions like normalizeSpawnedRunMetadata, mapToolContextToSpawnedRunMetadata, resolveSpawnedWorkspaceInheritance, and resolveIngressWorkspaceOverrideForSpawnedRun.

methods.name: normalizeSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Normalizes the spawned run metadata by trimming whitespace and removing empty fields.

methods.name: mapToolContextToSpawnedRunMetadata
methods.description: Maps agent group fields to spawned run metadata format.

methods.name: resolveSpawnedWorkspaceInheritance
methods.description: Determines the appropriate workspace directory based on config, explicit override, or agent context.

methods.name: resolveIngressWorkspaceOverrideForSpawnedRun
methods.description: Returns the workspace override for spawned runs, forwarding the workspace if the run is spawned.
